name.description: Name of the output style, shown in the `/config` picker and matched by the `outputStyle` setting. Defaults to the file name.

description.description: Description of the output style, shown in the `/config` picker.

keep-coding-instructions.description: Set true to keep Claude Code's built-in software engineering instructions — how to scope changes, write comments, verify work — alongside your own. Leave it out when Claude is not doing software engineering at all. Default: false.

force-for-plugin.description: Plugin output styles only: apply this style automatically whenever the plugin is enabled, overriding the user's `outputStyle` setting. Where several enabled plugins set it, the first one loaded wins. Default: false.
